title: Nova the Night Bus and the Missing Star Sticker
description: Nova helps a little car find a fallen star sticker along the evening route, then glides everyone home on her calm last stop.

Nova.role: Main character; a calm blueberry night bus
Nova.color: Long blueberry-blue body with silver trim, creamy white roof stripe, and soft gold headlight glow
Nova.bodyShape: Long rounded night bus with gentle curves, large side windows, six matching wheels, and no arms or hands
Nova.face: Large kind lavender windshield eyes and a warm friendly smile across the front panel
Nova.wheels: Six dark charcoal tires with silver hubcaps and tiny blueberry center dots
Nova.accessories: Silver side mirrors, a soft roof night lantern row, and a cream destination board shape with no readable text

Twinkle.role: Supporting character; a little star-loving city car
Twinkle.color: Small pearly white body with lavender doors and a gold star outline on the hood
Twinkle.bodyShape: Tiny rounded city car with four wheels and no arms or hands
Twinkle.face: Round teal windshield eyes and a hopeful little smile
Twinkle.wheels: Four small charcoal tires with lavender hubcaps

Star Sticker.role: Supporting prop; Twinkle's special star sticker
Star Sticker.appearance: A soft gold five-point star sticker with a tiny sparkle shine; no words

settingBible.Lantern Route: A gentle evening bus route with rounded cottages, street lanterns, a park path, a quiet depot, and a starry sky overhead
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded forms, clean single-scene compositions, gentle night-route colors, and no readable text

continuityRules: Nova keeps the same blueberry body, silver trim, cream roof stripe, lavender windshield eyes, six matching wheels, and soft roof lanterns on every page.
Nova and every vehicle have no human-like arms or hands.
Twinkle remains a tiny pearly white and lavender car with teal eyes and a gold star outline on the hood.
The gold star sticker is missing on Pages 4-9, found on Page 10, and back on Twinkle from Page 11 onward.
The calm last-stop depot appears on Pages 13-15 with warm porch lights.
The sky progresses from golden evening to lavender dusk, starry twilight, and moonlit night.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, contact sheet, text, badge, logo, or watermark.

pages.text: One calm evening, Nova the Night Bus rolled onto Lantern Route. Her blueberry sides glowed soft and bright.
pages.illustrationScene: Nova rolls along a lantern-lined street at golden evening with rounded cottages and a soft sky behind her.
pages.continuityNotes: Establish Nova's blueberry body, silver trim, cream roof stripe, lavender eyes, six wheels, silver mirrors, and roof lanterns.

pages.text: She began her gentle evening ride. Little cars waited for the calm last stop home.
pages.illustrationScene: Nova approaches a small group of friendly rounded cars waiting by a lantern post under early evening light.
pages.continuityNotes: Keep Nova locked. Supporting cars are simple with no arms.

pages.text: Tiny Twinkle rolled up with a hopeful smile. A gold star outline shone on her hood.
pages.illustrationScene: Small pearly white Twinkle rolls beside Nova's front wheel, gold star outline visible on her hood.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Twinkle's pearly white and lavender colors, teal eyes, four wheels, and gold star outline. Sticker still on Twinkle.

pages.text: But Twinkle’s special star sticker was missing! Only the empty outline remained.
pages.illustrationScene: Close view of Twinkle's hood showing the empty gold star outline while Twinkle looks worried and Nova watches kindly.
pages.continuityNotes: Problem: missing star sticker. Outline remains; sticker not present.

pages.text: “I need my star for the ride home,” Twinkle said. Nova listened with care.
pages.illustrationScene: Twinkle looks up at Nova beside the lantern post while the evening route stretches quietly ahead.
pages.continuityNotes: Problem continues. Nova has no arms. Twinkle's empty outline visible.

pages.text: “We can look together,” said Nova. She rolled slow so Twinkle could search.
pages.illustrationScene: Nova and Twinkle begin rolling slowly along the lantern path, scanning the roadside under dusk light.
pages.continuityNotes: Search begins. Sticker still missing. Designs locked.

pages.text: They checked near the flower boxes. Soft petals danced, but no star waited there.
pages.illustrationScene: Nova and Twinkle pause beside cottage flower boxes while petals drift; no sticker is visible.
pages.continuityNotes: Search beat. Help in progress. Empty outline still on Twinkle.

pages.text: They checked the park path. Lantern light made tiny sparkles on the grass.
pages.illustrationScene: Nova and Twinkle look along a grassy park path edged with lanterns under blue twilight.
pages.continuityNotes: Continue search. Sparkles are light on grass, not the sticker yet.

pages.text: Then Twinkle spotted a soft gold shine by a curb stone. “Could it be?”
pages.illustrationScene: Twinkle looks toward a small gold gleam near a curb stone while Nova waits patiently behind her.
pages.continuityNotes: Almost found. Show gleam clearly as the gold star sticker on the ground.

pages.text: They found the missing star sticker! Twinkle beeped with joy.
pages.illustrationScene: The gold five-point star sticker lies on the curb while Twinkle smiles and Nova's roof lanterns glow warmly.
pages.continuityNotes: Solution: sticker found. Sticker matches locked prop design. No arms—Twinkle receives it by gentle bumper tap or it rests ready to place.

pages.text: The star sticker settled back on Twinkle’s hood. It looked bright and safe again.
pages.illustrationScene: Twinkle's hood shows the gold star sticker restored inside the outline as Nova smiles beside her.
pages.continuityNotes: Sticker returned. Twinkle design complete again. Calm positive mood.

pages.text: Nova opened her doors for the calm last stop. Everyone rolled aboard gently.
pages.illustrationScene: Nova's side doors open as Twinkle and small friendly cars roll carefully aboard under twilight lanterns.
pages.continuityNotes: Doors open via bus mechanism only—no arms. Twinkle's sticker remains visible.

pages.text: Nova glided through the quiet streets. The depot lights glowed soft and ready.
pages.illustrationScene: Nova rolls toward a warm-lit night depot with Twinkle visible through a side window and stars above.
pages.continuityNotes: Journey home. Depot destination introduced. Designs locked.

pages.text: At the depot, Twinkle yawned a tiny yawn. The star sticker shimmered goodnight.
pages.illustrationScene: Nova parks at the quiet depot as Twinkle yawns near the open door with her star sticker shining softly.
pages.continuityNotes: Bedtime transition. Calm depot porch lights. Sticker still on Twinkle.

pages.text: That night, Nova rested under the quiet moon. Goodnight, Nova. Goodnight, Twinkle.
pages.illustrationScene: Nova rests at the depot beneath a crescent moon while Twinkle sleeps nearby with the gold star sticker glowing gently.
pages.continuityNotes: Calm bedtime ending. Nova keeps all locked features. Peaceful night scene.
